description: A lightweight, breathable tee designed for everyday wear and meaningful moments. Soft Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton feels gentle against the skin while the retail fit and classic crew neckline keep the look clean and easy to layer. The front features a warm, team-style graphic—‘Team Alina’ with a subtle arching accent—that reads as supportive and personal without shouting. Built with side seams, shoulder tape, and a ribbed knit collar to retain shape through regular wear. Ethically produced with tear-away label comfort and REACH certification, this shirt suits casual meetups, fundraising gatherings, and community events where quiet solidarity matters. Product features - 100% Airlume combed & ring-spun cotton (lightweight, breathable) - Retail fit with crew neckline for a neat, layered look - Side seams, ribbed knit collar, and shoulder tape for long-lasting shape - DTF/DTG printed graphics for crisp, vibrant front and sleeve designs - Tear-away label, REACH certified, ethically manufactured Care instructions - Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F) - Non-chlorine: bleach as needed - Tumble dry: low heat - Iron, steam or dry: medium heat - Do not dryclean
